text_block_list.text:
Midway through summer camp... Silence 
Suzuka showed no signs of recovering her 
condition.

And finally, during a mock race at the 
summer training camp, with everyone's 
expectations riding on her—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder... what her dream is... With 
what feelings... is she... running right 
now...?)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (No... I have to focus...!)

—It ended without her ever achieving 
results true to herself.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what's up with Silence Suzuka...? 
She's seemed off this entire summer 
training camp, right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
No way, I didn't even notice... Could it 
be that I've passed my peak...?

That night, outside the dorms, I found her 
standing all by herself.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
choice_data_list:
Something's been troubling you this whole 
time, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list: Is there anything I can do to help?
I wonder if there's anything I can do.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
choice_data_list: I'll be there for you, I promise

text_block_list.text:
She cast her eyes down for a moment... but 
soon, after a brief hesitation, she spoke.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Up until now, I only ever ran thinking 
about staying in the lead myself."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
“Still, lately... I can't help but worry 
about my competitors...”

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder what her dream is... What kind 
of thoughts is she running with right 
now...?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Everything I've done up until now 
was...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I can't stop thinking about things like 
that...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I just don't know... what to do.
choice_data_list:
...Don't worry about it, just run like 
yourself, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
choice_data_list:
Suzuka's running isn't something that 
crushes dreams

text_block_list.text:
The cheers, expectations, and buzz that 
rise with every race—this is no mere 
consolation, it is undeniable 'fact.'
choice_data_list: It's something that gives people strength.

It's something that gives people strength, 
you know.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Such a thing.
choice_data_list: At least I was, you know.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much. However...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Even so, the girl who lost was crying.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "...I'm sorry. Excuse me."

Surrounded by a heavy atmosphere, she 
headed back to the training camp lodge.
—The next morning.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (...My body... feels like lead.)

—Suddenly, for some reason, the distant 
roar of a racetrack could be heard 
drifting from the lounge.

text_block_list.name: TV Color Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Her pace isn't dropping at all! Silence 
Suzuka is fast! She's so fast—...!”

Peeking inside, I find Special Week 
intently watching race footage.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: S-So cool...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Guess I've still got a long way 
to go.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Suzuka-san! Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, having the real deal show up out of 
nowhere totally surprised me~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, that video...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Actually, I'm kinda in a bit of a 
slump right now.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I figured imagining running with 
Suzuka-san would cheer me right up!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Look, this part is amazing! It's only the 
middle leg, but she's pulling further and 
further ahead—...!

The footage Special Week is pointing at 
shows Silence Suzuka effortlessly pulling 
away and leaving the rest behind—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"This won't do at all...! Someone like 
me... someone like me is just...!"
Silence Suzuka quietly turned off the TV.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: —Suzuka-san?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry for looking without 
asking. Um... you didn't like that, did 
you?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...No, it's not like that. It's not that I 
hate it or anything.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Because... there's no way I could ever 
cheer anyone up.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh!? That's not true at all!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"B-Because look, I just love this part so 
much—...!"

Special Week hurriedly turned on the TV 
and rewound the footage.

text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Her pace isn't dropping at all! Silence 
Suzuka is fast! She's incredibly fast!”

text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"They can't reach her at all! No one can 
reach her—...!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I think I understand how the girls 
around here feel.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
She kept pulling further and further 
away... Honestly, I just couldn't keep up 
at all.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I couldn't help thinking that I blew 
it again...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (Yeah, you're right...)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—Still! That's precisely why I want to 
catch up, and the fire inside me is 
burning bright!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I will! One day, I'll catch up to her 
back!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I watch Suzuka-san, it makes me 
want to give it my all!

"Suzuka's running isn't something that 
crushes dreams."

"It's something that gives people 
strength."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (I see... I'm...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for looking up to me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Wh-Wh-What's got into you all of a 
sudden!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I... it's okay for me to run, right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Of course I do!? Wait, did something 
bad happen!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, no. It's nothing...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry about yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: And besides... thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't until this morning that I 
finally understood what you meant, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I can just stay the way I've always been, 
right?

Having overcome her anguish, Silence 
Suzuka was brimming with motivation, as if 
to make up for the summer training camp so 
far.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
What should we do? Should we maybe climb a 
mountain...?
choice_data_list: Build up your strength on the beach!
Let's run a full lap around the mountain!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Building muscle on the sandy beach... is 
it? ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I enjoy training while looking at the sea, 
so I'm looking forward to it.

With those words, she offered a smile for 
the first time in a while.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: A-Around the entire mountain, you say...?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, but somehow, I feel like I can do 
this.

On that day, for the first time in several 
months, I saw her running freely.
